# machine (started after five quiet minutes, mains power, the `performance` profile, nobody at it), Bend 2.0.40, bend-ml-tensor-array@0.1.20.0.
# gen <dir> <prompt> 8, alternated shuffled rounds. first_ms: the program's own clock from the start of the prompt to the first new token;
# ms_per_token_after: from the first new token to the eighth (the same code in both programs; on 16 threads it depends on how long the threads
# have been running, so it is no control: NOTES, 2026-11-12). One thread is pinned (taskset -c 3) and counted by perf stat
# (cpu_core/instructions/u, cpu_core/cycles/u, the whole run). ids_bits: sha256 of the prompt ids, the generated ids and their logit bits.
